summary: The overall rate of moving has fallen to an all-time low, and renters now move far less than in 1988.
realLife: The 2017 overall mover rate was 11.0 percent, close to the 2016 record low of 11.2; renters moved at 35.2 percent in 1988.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau, Overall Mover Rate Remains at an All-time Low (2017): https://www.census.gov/library/stories/2017/12/lower-moving-rate.html
inGame: needs: a yearly moves count from the history run, for a line about how rare moving has become.

turns.what: A world where moving rises: a boom town pulls many households in.
turns.pulledBy: the economy's job demand by place
turns.writesBack: more move records in that year, told as a wave

turns.what: The year of the move is an ordinary year and no one comments.
